description: This file defines the GroupShapes class which provides various shape rendering methods for UI components such as tabs, cards, columns, and containers within the OrchardCore CMS framework. It includes shape methods for rendering HTML content with Bootstrap classes and manages shape metadata.

classes.name: GroupShapes
classes.description: Provides shape rendering methods for UI components like tabs, cards, columns, and containers in OrchardCore.

methods.name: AdminTabs
methods.description: Renders a tab navigation list based on shape properties.

methods.name: Card
methods.description: Renders a card component with header and toggle button.

methods.name: CardContainer
methods.description: Renders a container holding multiple card shapes.

methods.name: Column
methods.description: Renders a column layout with child shapes.

methods.name: ColumnContainer
methods.description: Renders a row container with multiple columns.

methods.name: TabContainer
methods.description: Renders a container for tab shapes with navigation.

methods.name: LocalNavigation
methods.description: Renders a local navigation shape, morphing its type to 'AdminTabs'.
